headline: Panel Duo's Transformation: Investors Focus on Advanced Packaging Technology Progress | Industry & Finance
summary: Innolux and AUO each hit share price highs as investors focus on their transformation into advanced semiconductor packaging. Analysts say prices reflect the transformation theme.
why: Innolux and AUO are Taiwanese display panel makers, and a shift into chip packaging would link display manufacturers to the semiconductor supply chain. Investors track such pivots for revaluation potential.
